raw:
Robert Kubica won one Grand Prix for BMW Sauber: the 2008 Canadian Grand Prix at Circuit Gilles Villeneuve, where he started 2nd and finished first.

The searches also covered his other BMW Sauber results in 2007–2009 (for example, second in Japan 2008, third in Italy 2008, and fourth or lower in several other races), and none of those were wins. The searches did not retrieve every race result for 2007–2009, so this rests on the results that were returned.

ANSWER: 1
